title: What's next for Democrats after the midterms. And, a look at the outstanding races
description: Democrats have regained control of Congress. They have a long list of investigations into Trump planned. And, not all races have been called. Here's a look at how they could affect the Dems' majority.

title: Sen. Gillibrand says Democrats must end Iran war, hold Trump accountable. But how?
description: Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand spoke with Morning Edition about Democrats' priorities, from lowering costs to ending the Iran war. But questions remain about how they'll deliver.

title: Trump's arch is on the verge of federal approval. But a judge could block construction
description: A federal panel will meet to consider the arch for final approval on Thursday, and the government said it may begin construction later that same day. Critics hope a judge will intervene last-minute.

title: The South flexes political power in midterms, sets regional influence in 2028 election
description: Tuesday's dramatic midterm results have transformed the electoral map, ensuring the path to future power for Democrats and Republicans must run through the South and its diverse voting population.

title: Democrats will control Congress. Will it change Trump's approach to foreign policy?
description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with historian and journalist Anne Applebaum about how much a Democrat-led Congress can steer foreign policy.

title: Morning news brief
description: Democrats are planning out how to tackle their agenda in the new year, ballots are still being counted in some undecided races, Trump avoids taking the blame after GOP midterm losses.

title: Democrats will take control of Congress next year. What does it mean for the economy?
description: The Democratic gains in this week's midterm elections will bring a different business climate to Washington. But the overall economy should be OK.

title: Democrats and Republicans reflect on midterm results and the message sent by voters
description: The 2026 election proved to be very good for Democrats and very bad for President Trump and Republicans. But there are still races outstanding that can tell us what mattered to voters this year.

title: Trump blames GOP candidates and Fox News for midterm losses
description: President Trump has blamed GOP candidates and Fox News in the wake of the sweeping Democratic sweep during the midterm elections.

title: What's the future of the Democratic party in Texas, amid historic midterm wins?
description: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with former Texas state Sen. Wendy Davis, a Democrat, about Texas flipping blue and what it means for future elections.
